name: Blanes (Spain)
description: Red field with a white cross throughout, its arms one sixth of the height.
history: The flag was approved on 3 January 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1999 of 18 January 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a white cross throughout of arms 1/6 of the height, a heraldic flag with the arms of the lords of Blanes.

features.role: cross throughout with arms 1/6 of the height
